title: Prove exact alignment envelopes for rank-seven scalar streams
body:
## Summary

```text
Frozen PR3042 scalar reference streams
                Fraction bits   Maximum row l1   Extra signed width
forward               4               302               13
backward              5               169               13
common layout         5             <=302               14
```

Add only `research/rank7-scalar-lattice/`. The widths are beyond a signed P-bit integral input component, in the explicit free-monomial scalar reference model. This supplies a reference-level producer/consumer ledger for PR3080/3081, not a physical caller or new kappa.

Every fractional ADD source aligns at the common five-bit grid. The complete ordinary outputs are integral again, so their fractional guard bits close at the reference endpoint. Intermediate target fractions cannot be discarded.

[Proof, exact source pins, reproduction and open questions](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4b763c20da54e4e29e3edfdd1c3e251f5ede37e0/research/rank7-scalar-lattice/README.md).

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3080/3081 leave actual source alignment, range and fractional-bit lifetime unbound. Individual ADD denominators divide eight, but that alone does not bound the complete stream.
  **After:** source-bound exact propagation reaches `3/16` forward and `-3/32` backward. Four/five fractional bits suffice and one fewer fails in the free model. All 17,449 scalar events per orientation and all 632 ordinary endpoints are checked; 91 private buffers return.
- A separate fixed-integer interpreter reproduces both norms and grids without importing the rational propagator. Thirteen behavioral groups cover semantic/source mutations, insufficient precision, formal warp aliasing, dirty targets, private cleanup and occupied-output preservation.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay, optimized replay, byte-identical Python 3.13 evidence, read-only Git-free export, Ruff checks, source compilation and all 21 committed-file byte comparisons pass locally. Hosted CI and independent human review remain separate.

```sh
TMPDIR="$RUN/tmp" python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/rank7-scalar-lattice
```

`RUN` is an existing external directory with a `tmp` subdirectory. Only standard-library dependencies are needed. Canonical main remains `d8e0f83f`, priority revision 6. Source and overlap limitations are recorded in `CHECKS.json`.

Credit PR3080/3081, PR3078/3076/3060/3056, dcharb78/PR3042, Jeremy Kothe/PR3015, Marius-Paul Dumitrean/PR2979, Cinna Davis, icekylinx and the retained native/geometry/owner lineage. Frozen words, scripts and notices are byte-identical. Development used substantial automated assistance.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** research.

The physical non-scalar conversions and recursive calls are not simulated. Their grid/amplification effects, approximate child defects, bit ownership/routing, clean stock and full cost remain open. No production precision charge, selected frontier, shared verifier or frozen predecessor changes.
